title: Welcome to your next chapter
tag: SORT MY COVER · BY LEAD VELOCITY
headline:
Better conversations.
A clearer journey.
say: Welcome to Lead Velocity. This guide walks you through onboarding and how your Sort My Cover leads reach you. It applies whichever plan you have chosen. Your agreement and invoice set out your own allocation and fees. Let's get your practice ready for the right conversations.

title: Sign. Pay. Get started.
items: Complete the relevant details and return the signed PDF.
Use the reference and banking details on your invoice.
Email the team so we can confirm receipt.
say: Start by reviewing your agreement, completing the relevant details and returning the signed PDF. Pay your invoice using its banking details and payment reference, then send us your proof of payment. We begin working on your campaign once payment has been made. Campaign activation follows onboarding and the final readiness checks.

title: Your private broker portal
items: Track the leads allocated to your practice.
Follow up and keep outcomes current.
say: We provide your broker portal login details separately. Sign in through the broker portal on the Lead Velocity website. Your account is linked to your practice, so you see your own leads and can track their progress. Keep your login private, and use the password recovery option if you need to reset it.

title: Help us introduce you well
items: A short biography and a clear photograph.
Practice name, contact information and notification number.
An introduction video or voice note.
say: Next, confirm your practice details and the WhatsApp number you want us to use for lead notifications. Share a short biography and a clear photograph for your introduction card. We can use initials while your photograph is being arranged. An introduction video or voice note is optional. We will guide you through approving your introduction.

title: A calendar that works for you
items: Choose the days and times you can meet.
Online, telephone or in person, as agreed.
Confirm the calendar and booking arrangements with us.
say: Tell us your working hours, preferred appointment methods and availability. Where applicable, connect your calendar with our guidance. Keep your availability up to date and let us know about changes. Before going live, we check the agreed booking arrangements and notification channels together, so appointments can fit around your practice.

title: Your plan funds the journey
headline:
The majority goes
towards advertising.
sub: Your chosen tier · One joined-up service
items: Campaigns designed around the agreed audience.
Creative, WhatsApp nurturing, booking support and follow-up.
say: Whichever tier you choose, the majority of your plan fee goes towards advertising. The rest supports the service that turns interest into a useful conversation: campaign creative, WhatsApp nurturing, booking support, reminders and our team's work. Your specific fee and lead allocation remain those in your agreement. We will not assume every broker has the same budget.

title: From interest to a conversation
items: Sort My Cover campaign or enquiry.
say: The client first shows interest through a Sort My Cover campaign or enquiry. With their consent, our WhatsApp process follows up, helps establish their needs and moves the conversation towards an appointment where appropriate. We introduce the adviser and provide the agreed lead information, so you have context before you make contact.

title: Nurturing keeps the client informed
messages: Thanks for your enquiry. May we help arrange a conversation with an adviser?
Your appointment details are ready. Please confirm, or tell us if you need another time.
Need to change your plans? Let us know. You can opt out at any time.
say: Clients receive consistent WhatsApp follow-up, notifications and appointment reminders. They can opt in or opt out at any time, and can tell us if their plans change. That ongoing contact helps us identify attendance concerns ahead of the appointment wherever possible. It supports attendance, but it cannot guarantee that every client will show up.

title: Goodwill starts with rescheduling
tag: 08 · IF A CLIENT DOES NOT ATTEND
items: Help the client find another suitable appointment.
If rescheduling does not work, apply the agreed goodwill terms.
Because nurturing and follow-up are part of our service.
say: If a client does not attend, our first priority is to do our best to reschedule the appointment. If that does not work, we replace the lead in line with the goodwill terms in your agreement. This is a goodwill gesture because our nurturing process already works to keep clients engaged and flag changes early. We stand behind that process and work with you to recover the opportunity.

title: Keep your lead journey moving
items: Use the context supplied with your lead.
Keep outcomes and notes current in your portal.
Help us improve the next conversation.
say: Once a lead reaches you, follow up promptly and keep its progress up to date in your portal. Record the outcome and share useful feedback with our team. That helps us understand what is working and where support is needed. Your own advice, quotations and client relationship remain your responsibility as the financial adviser or insurance broker.

title: Ready for your next chapter?
tag: SORT MY COVER · BY LEAD VELOCITY
headline:
Your practice.
Your next opportunity.
sub: Sign → Pay → Complete onboarding → Go live
say: Your next steps are simple: sign your agreement, pay your invoice and complete onboarding with us. We will confirm campaign activation after the readiness checks. If you need help, email howzit at lead velocity dot co dot zed ay, or reply to your onboarding conversation. Welcome aboard. We look forward to helping your practice grow.
